pages.name: About
pages.seoTitle: About Vela — the band, the record, the road
pages.seoDescription: Who Vela is and how they work — a self-produced, self-booked four-piece who record everything live in one room. No label between you and the band.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Vela is a four-piece who write songs for the small hours — the ones you play on the drive home when the city has gone quiet. Formed in a shared flat over a winter of power cuts, the band built its sound the way it builds everything: live, in one room, with the lights low.

Three records in, they still self-produce, still tour in a van they own, and still answer the fan mail themselves. Small Hours, the new album, was cut to tape in the same flat where the first demos were made — a full circle nobody planned and everybody noticed.
This site is where the band puts everything first — the releases, the dates, the notes from the studio floor, and the merch that keeps the van on the road. No label between you and them.
